- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The civil war lasted until 2009 when the government defeated the Tamil Tigers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ethnic tensions continue to influence political decision-making, with both Sinhalese and Tamil parties advocating for their communities' interests.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The current political climate in Sri Lanka is characterized by instability and uncertainty, with a continually evolving constitution.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 2018 constitutional crisis involved the President attempting to remove the Prime Minister and replace him with a loyalist.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government created the Office of National Unity and Reconciliation in 2015 to promote inter-ethnic harmony and national unity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Office for Reparations was established in 2018 to provide reparations to those harmed during the civil war.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government initiated a program to return land seized during the war to its rightful owners.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government has taken steps to address Tamil community grievances, including releasing Tamil political prisoners and implementing a national language policy recognizing Tamil as an official language.
